findings.title: Mechanical seal leak on pump P-104B
findings.note: Product weeping at the seal gland, drip tray half full. Seal flush pressure below the value on the datasheet.

findings.title: Coupling guard missing on pump P-102A
findings.note: Guard removed during last maintenance and not refitted. Rotating coupling exposed at walkway height.

findings.title: Pressure gauge PI-1041 unreadable
findings.note: Gauge glass cracked and face fogged. Reading cannot be confirmed during rounds.

findings.title: Corrosion at baseplate anchor bolts
findings.note: Surface rust and section loss on two of four anchor bolts of P-103.

findings.title: Vibration route tags out of date
findings.note: Route tags show readings from the previous quarter. Data in the CMMS is current.

findings.title: External corrosion at support shoe, line 6"-P-2104
findings.note: Pitting where the pipe rests on the shoe. Wall loss suspected, UT thickness check requested.

findings.title: Damaged and wet insulation on steam line
findings.note: Cladding split over 1.5 m, insulation saturated. Risk of corrosion under insulation.

findings.title: Short bolt engagement on flange FL-2231
findings.note: Two studs do not show full thread engagement through the nut.

findings.title: Handwheel missing on isolation valve HV-2210
findings.note: Valve operated with a cheater bar. Handwheel found on the rack floor.

findings.title: Faded line identification labels
findings.note: Flow direction and service labels illegible on four lines near the battery limit.

findings.title: Temporary hose left connected
findings.note: Utility hose connected to a drain point with no tag or permit reference.

findings.title: Crack in bund wall near drain valve
findings.note: Vertical crack about 40 cm long. Bund integrity cannot be guaranteed until repaired.

findings.title: Bund drain valve found open
findings.note: Drain valve DV-31 open with no one attending. Closed and locked on the spot, reported to the shift lead.

findings.title: Level gauge on T-301 differs from DCS
findings.note: Local gauge reads 62%, DCS shows 58%. Calibration requested.

findings.title: Vent screen clogged on T-303
findings.note: Bird debris on the vent screen. Risk of vacuum during pump-out.

findings.title: Coating breakdown on lower shell course
findings.note: Coating failure in patches on the north side. No active corrosion yet.

findings.title: Overfilled cable tray
findings.note: Cables above the tray side rails along 3 m of the main run.

findings.title: Panel door left open on MCC-2 section 4
findings.note: Door open with the latch broken. Enclosure rating compromised.

findings.title: Missing fire stopping at cable penetration
findings.note: Wall penetration between MCC room and corridor not sealed.

findings.title: No arc flash labels on switchgear SG-02
findings.note: Incident energy and PPE category labels missing on three cubicles.

findings.title: Hot spot on breaker Q12 terminals
findings.note: Thermography shows 38 degrees C above ambient on phase L2. Load to be reduced until repaired.

findings.title: Materials stored in front of panels
findings.note: Spare parts boxes blocking the 1 m clearance in front of MCC-2.

findings.title: Steam trap failed open
findings.note: Trap ST-118 discharging live steam to drain.

findings.title: Safety valve certificate expired
findings.note: PSV-201 test certificate expired three weeks ago. No extension on file.

findings.title: Water treatment log incomplete
findings.note: Daily conductivity readings missing for two days last week.

findings.title: Missing insulation on steam header
findings.note: Bare section of about 2 m on the main header, burn risk at shoulder height.

findings.title: Emergency pull-cord slack on conveyor C-204
findings.note: Pull-cord sags about 30 cm between supports. Stop switch did not trip on test.

findings.title: Guarding gap at conveyor tail pulley
findings.note: Gap of about 15 cm between guard and frame at the tail pulley.

findings.title: Hydraulic oil leak under press PR-2
findings.note: Oil on the floor around the press base, absorbent applied.

findings.title: Damaged floor at walkway crossing
findings.note: Broken concrete edge at the forklift crossing. Trip hazard.

findings.title: Loose handrail on access stairway
findings.note: Two handrail brackets loose on the mezzanine stairs.

findings.title: Corrosion at column base, grid line C4
findings.note: Paint loss and surface corrosion at the base plate of the column.

findings.title: Damaged racking upright, aisle 6
findings.note: Upright bent at the first beam level after an impact. Bay not offloaded.

findings.title: Rack load signs missing
findings.note: Safe working load signs missing at the ends of aisles 3 and 4.

findings.title: No eyewash at forklift charging area
findings.note: Battery charging area has no eyewash station within 10 m.

findings.title: Worn pedestrian walkway markings
findings.note: Yellow walkway lines worn through at the dispatch doors.

findings.title: Pallets stored in fire exit route
findings.note: Two pallets blocking the exit route to door D-4.

findings.title: Extinguisher inspection overdue
findings.note: Extinguisher FE-117 last inspected 14 months ago.

findings.title: Safety shower flow test not recorded
findings.note: No weekly flow test records for the shower at the acid unloading point.

findings.title: Exit sign not illuminated
findings.note: Exit sign above door D-2 not lit. Emergency lighting test due.

findings.title: Fire hose reel obstructed
findings.note: Hose reel HR-05 blocked by stored drums.

findings.title: Emergency station complete and in good order
findings.note: Station at the tank farm entrance checked, all items present and tagged.
